decision.summaryForCoordinator: The dispatch's distinctive prohibition is the one worth reporting first, because it is where the family's own template would have broken this artifact. G08 v2 and G19 v1 each carry a leftoverNameNote recording that no gate leftover-join exists, and their joins cite it as warrant to exist. G15 v7 carries no such field — zero occurrences, and its whatThisCloses keys are leftoverDesignClosedIfAcceptedAndRecorded, leftoverDesignRemainingOnDR103, gates2and3HoldForDR103 and dr120Standing. A copied template would have asserted a field that is not there.
